```renyi
public function count_words(text: Text) returns List of WordCount
  purpose: Count every lower-cased word, most frequent first.
  example: count_words("a b a")
    is [WordCount(word: "a", occurrences: 2), WordCount(word: "b", occurrences: 1)]
  example: count_words("") is []

  let mutable counts: Map of Text to Integer be {}
  for each raw_word in text.to_lower().split(" ") where not raw_word.is_empty()
    let current be counts.get(raw_word) otherwise 0
    set counts to counts.set(key: raw_word, value: current + 1)
  end

  let mutable entries: List of WordCount be []
  for each word, occurrences in counts
    set entries to entries.append(WordCount(word: word, occurrences: occurrences))
  end

  return for each entry in entries sorted by entry.occurrences descending collect entry
end
```

```renyi
public function count_words(text: Text) returns List of WordCount
  purpose: Count every lower-cased word, most frequent first.
  example: count_words("a b a")
    is [WordCount(word: "a", occurrences: 2), WordCount(word: "b", occurrences: 1)]
  example: count_words("") is []

  let mutable words: List of Text be []
  let mutable current_word be ""

  for each character in text.to_lower().characters()
    if character.matches(raw "[a-z0-9]") then
      set current_word to "{current_word}{character}"
    otherwise
      if current_word.is_empty() then
        ignore words.length()
      otherwise
        set words to words.append(current_word)
        set current_word to ""
      end
    end
  end

  if current_word.is_empty() then
    ignore words.length()
  otherwise
    set words to words.append(current_word)
  end

  let mutable counts: Map of Text to Integer be {}

  for each word in words
    let previous be counts.get(word) otherwise 0
    set counts to counts.set(key: word, value: previous + 1)
  end

  let entries be
    for each word, occurrences in counts
    sorted by occurrences descending
    collect WordCount(word: word, occurrences: occurrences)

  return entries
end
```

```renyi
public function count_words(text: Text) returns List of WordCount
  purpose: Count every lower-cased word, most frequent first.
  example: count_words("a b a")
    is [WordCount(word: "a", occurrences: 2), WordCount(word: "b", occurrences: 1)]
  example: count_words("") is []

  let mutable cleaned be ""
  for each character in text.to_lower().characters()
    if character.matches(raw "[a-z0-9]") then
      set cleaned to "{cleaned}{character}"
    otherwise
      set cleaned to "{cleaned} "
    end
  end

  let mutable counts: List of WordCount be []
  for each word in cleaned.split(" ") where not word.is_empty()
    let mutable next_counts: List of WordCount be []
    let mutable found be false

    for each counted_entry in counts
      if counted_entry.word is word then
        set next_counts to next_counts.append(WordCount(word: counted_entry.word, occurrences: counted_entry.occurrences + 1))
        set found to true
      otherwise
        set next_counts to next_counts.append(counted_entry)
      end
    end

    if not found then
      set next_counts to next_counts.append(WordCount(word: word, occurrences: 1))
    end

    set counts to next_counts
  end

  let mutable result: List of WordCount be []
  for each counted_entry in counts
    let mutable sorted_entries: List of WordCount be []
    let mutable inserted be false

    for each existing_entry in result
      if not inserted and counted_entry.occurrences is greater than existing_entry.occurrences then
        set sorted_entries to sorted_entries.append(counted_entry)
        set inserted to true
      end

      set sorted_entries to sorted_entries.append(existing_entry)
    end

    if not inserted then
      set sorted_entries to sorted_entries.append(counted_entry)
    end

    set result to sorted_entries
  end

  return result
end
```

```renyi
    is [WordCount(word: "a", occurrences: 2), WordCount(word: "b", occurrences: 1)]

  let mutable words: List of Text be []
  let mutable current_characters: List of Text be []

  for each character in text.to_lower().characters()
    if character.matches(raw "^[a-z0-9]$") then
      set current_characters to current_characters.append(character)
    otherwise
      if not current_characters.is_empty then
        set words to words.append(current_characters.join(""))
        set current_characters to []
      end
    end
  end

  if not current_characters.is_empty then
    set words to words.append(current_characters.join(""))
  end

  let counts be for each word in words group by word count
  let results be
    for each word, occurrences in counts
    sorted by occurrences descending
    collect WordCount(word: word, occurrences: occurrences)

  return results
end
```

```renyi
public function count_words(text: Text) returns List of WordCount
  purpose: Count every lower-cased word, most frequent first.
  example: count_words("a b a")
    is [WordCount(word: "a", occurrences: 2), WordCount(word: "b", occurrences: 1)]
  example: count_words("") is []

  let lower_text be text.to_lower()
  let mutable words: List of Text be []
  let mutable current_characters: List of Text be []

  for each character in lower_text.characters()
    if character.matches(raw "^[a-z0-9]$") then
      set current_characters to current_characters.append(character)
    otherwise
      if not current_characters.is_empty() then
        let completed_word be current_characters.join("")
        set words to words.append(completed_word)
        set current_characters to []
      end
    end
  end

  if not current_characters.is_empty() then
    let final_word be current_characters.join("")
    set words to words.append(final_word)
  end

  let mutable counts: Map of Text to Integer be {}
  let mutable ordered_words: List of Text be []

  for each word in words
    let previous_occurrences be counts.get(word) otherwise 0
    if previous_occurrences is 0 then
      set ordered_words to ordered_words.append(word)
    end
    set counts to counts.set(key: word, value: previous_occurrences + 1)
  end

  let mutable sorted_counts: List of WordCount be []

  for each source_word in ordered_words
    let occurrences be counts.get(source_word) otherwise crash with "missing count for {source_word}"
    let entry be WordCount(word: source_word, occurrences: occurrences)
    let mutable inserted be false
    let mutable next_counts: List of WordCount be []

    for each existing in sorted_counts
      if not inserted and entry.occurrences is greater than existing.occurrences then
        set next_counts to next_counts.append(entry)
        set inserted to true
      end
      set next_counts to next_counts.append(existing)
    end

    if not inserted then
      set next_counts to next_counts.append(entry)
    end

    set sorted_counts to next_counts
  end

  return sorted_counts
end
```
